annotations.text:
OPTION A — SALON (light)
Ink-on-paper, the brief's default. Neo-grotesque (Space Grotesk) + mono EXIF captions, exposed hairline grid, huge negative space — a single photo owns the frame. Quiet, museum, timeless.
TRADEOFF — less loud; leans classic/gallery.

OPTION B — POSTER (dark)
Keeps the dark signature, pushed brutalist: full-bleed hero + giant Anton wordmark (mix-blend), kinetic marquee, broken oversized grid, one signal accent used only for state.
TRADEOFF — bolder, more to art-direct; dark competes a little more with the photographs.
